definitions.eligible_function: at least 20 AST nodes and at least 15 physical body lines
definitions.normalization: identifiers, argument names, function names, and comments only
definitions.semantic_preservation: literals, operations, exception flow, SQL, and call targets remain exact
definitions.duplicated_loc: sum of participating function body-line spans per group
definitions.near_miss: normalized AST token 5-shingle weighted-Jaccard similarity >=0.85 after bounded rare-shingle indexing
